1_MVP_three_quarter.caption: LH-1 MVP (stage 0 of the starter): 1344 x 894 x 1190 mm, about 114 kg (estimate); the starter's own frame, gantry, deck strips, drawer, enclosure and control compartment; ONE carriage with the eight-channel 30-300 uL tool held by the manual clamp MCL-1 over plate 1 (B2); passive deck: p300 tips G3, reservoir F2, plates B2 and B4, tip waste B1, every other place blanked; no dock, no shelf; door, roof and right panel hidden.  Designed and checked in the model, not built

2_MVP_deck_top_labelled.caption: MVP deck from above: passive places only on the starter's grid (rows F, A, B, G); p300 tip frame G3 (refill wafer loaded by hand), 12-column reservoir F2, two 96-well plates B2 and B4 on plain inserts, tip waste B1 with its tip-check gate (VC-2 camera not fitted); every other window closed by a plain insert, the shaker window F4 by the MVP-only blank IN-B

3_MVP_carriage_and_tool.caption: MVP carriage A with the eight-channel 30-300 uL tool (tips on): Z axis, LGA35 plunger pusher with its RETRACTED switch, cradle force switch, the full design's tool plate on three vee seats, held by the manual fork clamp MCL-1 in the latch channel (finger tab in front of the bracket, one M5 set screw at 0.30 N m: preload 550-916 N, CALCULATED); changing the tool is a manual job

4_MVP_beside_full_starter_same_scale.caption: Same scale: the MVP (left) and the full starter S (right).  Same frame, gantry, deck strips, drawer, enclosure and control compartment; the starter adds carriage B, the gripper, the latch, the eight-bay dock with tools, the shelf with towers, the deck modules, TC-1, tip parking, cameras and the extraction fan
